scientific_integrity: Finite computations check explicitly bounded cases; infinite conclusions have a separate transfer-matrix and inequality proof. Historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Pointwise named transitive complete tournament bases only, ordered distinct new pairs, and cyclic-triangle-free oriented graphs permitting missing edges; not arbitrary bases or random-vertex probabilities.
title: Exact two-type spectra over transitive tournaments in the directed-triangle-free homogeneous oriented graph
